display_title: [Mosaic GPU] Select `.blockN` scale qualifiers for `tcgen05.mma` by a…

head_commit.message:
[Mosaic GPU] Select `.blockN` scale qualifiers for `tcgen05.mma` by architecture.

For 4-bit block-scaled `tcgen05.mma`, the `.block16` / `.block32` qualifiers were only used when K=96 instructions were issued, and `.scale_vec::2X` / `::4X` otherwise. The two are aliases for the default instruction K, and `.blockN` is additionally valid for larger K. Which one to emit is therefore a property of the target, not of the instruction sizes: keep `.scale_vec::NX` on sm_100, where the assembler rejects `.blockN`, and use `.blockN` on sm_103 and later.

This removes the dependency of the qualifier on the K decomposition, in preparation for supporting more instruction K sizes.

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Validate array shapes in custom_root (#42856)

head_commit.message:
Validate array shapes in custom_root (#42856)

custom_root requires the root-finding problem f(x) = 0 to be well-posed under the Implicit Function Theorem, where f maps to a residual space with the same structure and array shapes as initial_guess.

Previously, custom_root only called _check_tree, verifying PyTree structure without checking array leaf shapes. When a rectangular function (such as f: R^n -> R) was provided, it was silently accepted at construction. Without vmap, scalar-vector broadcasting could mask the mismatch, but under vmap, rank differences between the residual and root caused an AssertionError in _unbroadcast during reverse-mode AD transposition.

This commit:
1. Adds _check_shapes validation for f, solve, and tangent_solve against initial_guess in custom_root, matching the validation pattern in custom_linear_solve.
2. Clarifies in the custom_root docstrings that f, solve, and tangent_solve must match both the structure and shapes of initial_guess.
3. Adds shape mismatch test cases to test_custom_root_errors in tests/custom_root_test.py.

Fixes #42856.

Signed-off-by: Roxen-AS <akash.arjun12@gmail.com>

display_title: [XLA:CPU] Add vectorized exp2 intrinsics for f32 and f64 on CPU.

head_commit.message:
[XLA:CPU] Add vectorized exp2 intrinsics for f32 and f64 on CPU.

XLA:CPU previously lowered `exp2` to scalar `libm` calls (`exp2f` and `exp2`).

Add C++ bitcode intrinsics (`xla.exp2.*`) in `xla/codegen/intrinsic/cpp/` for `f32` and `f64` across scalar and vector widths up to 512 bits, accurate to 1.0 ULP (`bf16` and `f16` `exp2` upcast to `f32`).

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Lower size-1 unary reductions directly to reshape

head_commit.message:
Lower size-1 unary reductions directly to reshape

Unary reductions whose reduced dimensions all have static size 1 (including per-shard reductions from `unreduced` reshards and sharded reductions under `jax_partitioning`) previously emitted a trivial `stablehlo.reduce` and relied on XLA's algebraic simplifier to fold it away. Emit `stablehlo.reshape` directly during MLIR lowering (and return the input unchanged when `axes` is empty) so downstream StableHLO/HLO consumers do not see redundant reductions.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1029067741

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Add `jax_cpu_flush_subnormals` flag to allow disabling FTZ on CPU.

head_commit.message:
Add `jax_cpu_flush_subnormals` flag to allow disabling FTZ on CPU.

XLA:CPU currently flushes subnormal floats to zero unconditionally during execution. This change adds an opt-in `jax_cpu_flush_subnormals` flag (default `True`), makes the XLA:CPU PJRT runtime honor it, and adds a default-disabled `cpu_subnormals` test backend so follow-up changes can test and fix subnormal handling on CPU without changing default behavior.
